Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Markets is the engine behind everything our clients trade, across crypto and traditional assets. As a Markets Operations Associate, you will work directly with the Head of Markets and our Trading Operations & Asset Lifecycle teams. You will help keep the business running smoothly, measured and ready to scale.

It’s an entry-level role with real responsibility from day one. You’ll see how a front-to-back trading business works, learn from experienced Markets professionals, and make a visible difference to how we operate and perform.

What you’ll do 

  • Keep trading running: monitor daily processes and help resolve issues before they reach clients.
  • Run the asset lifecycle: take crypto and securities listings and delistings from request to go-live.
  • Keep Markets on track: own the weekly and monthly reporting and coordinate across teams. 
  • Remove bottlenecks: work with Trading, Product, Engineering and Compliance to unblock initiatives. 
  • Make it scale: spot manual work worth automating and improve our processes, including with AI tools.

Who you are 

  • You have a degree in Finance, Economics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Trading experience: You’ve already worked close to trading or trading operations, and early-career or internship experience counts.
  • Curious about digital assets: Prior experience is a bonus, and a keen interest in the space is what counts
  • You are structured and detail-minded. You can analyse data, juggle priorities and explain results clearly.
  • You take ownership and follow a problem through to a solution.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Tax Transfer Pricing team designs, implements, and defends the intercompany pricing policies that support Stripe’s global operating model, ensuring pricing between Stripe entities is compliant, defensible, and aligned with how the business creates value.

As Stripe expands its product portfolio and international footprint, our transfer pricing policies and documentation must evolve alongside the business. Transactions between Stripe affiliates are becoming increasingly complex and, in some cases, share characteristics with transactions commonly undertaken by financial services institutions. These arrangements, including those supporting Stripe’s stablecoin-related activities, may also be subject to scrutiny from regulators that oversee the financial services sector. We are seeking an experienced Transfer Pricing Specialist with financial services expertise to help develop practical, scalable transfer pricing policies, work through the tax and regulatory considerations relevant to intercompany arrangements, and provide subject matter expertise in audit defense and dispute resolution.

What you’ll do

The Financial Services Transfer Pricing Strategist will be a hands-on, collaborative member of the team responsible for developing and implementing compliant, practical transfer pricing policies and processes. The role will focus on transactions between Stripe’s legal entities that have characteristics commonly associated with the financial services sector, including intercompany arrangements supporting Stripe’s stablecoin-related activities.

This individual will work closely with teams across the organization and must be an excellent communicator who can explain complex transfer pricing concepts clearly to non-tax audiences. The ideal candidate will have transfer pricing experience in payments, fintech, banking, or another regulated financial services environment, as well as a track record of partnering effectively with cross-functional teams and other members of the tax organization.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with teams within and outside of Finance to develop, execute, and maintain transfer pricing policies for Stripe’s current and future operating structure and product offerings with a strong moral compass and integrity
  • Analyze financial information to design, prepare, and review detailed calculations, assist in preparing legal entity forecasts, and support the tax provision process
  • Address the transfer pricing impacts of special projects related to restructurings, acquisitions, and corporate initiatives, and ensure operating models are fit for purpose in the context of evolving global tax and transfer pricing frameworks and other regulations that apply to transactions between affiliates
  • Build relationships with product and business leaders to understand their organizational structure and activities, and adapt transfer pricing policies in response to changes
  • Assist finance, legal, and tax teams in government and regulatory audits, and support Stripe’s participation in tax audits, advance pricing agreements, and competent authority proceedings
  • Prepare and maintain transfer pricing documentation and compliance in accordance with Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) guidelines and local tax and regulatory requirements, ensuring efficiency and quality across a subset of assigned jurisdictions
  • Build or simplify transfer pricing models for clarity, efficiency, and ease of use

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree or higher in accounting, economics, business, law, or a related field, and 10+ years of relevant experience
  • Strong knowledge of global transfer pricing laws and regulations, experience with international tax planning for a multinational, and experience in financial services, banking, fintech, payments, or another regulated industry
  • Experience managing transfer pricing documentation and compliance; practical experience with transfer pricing dispute resolution, including audits, advance pricing agreement negotiations, and competent authority negotiations; and experience developing, maintaining, and implementing intercompany agreements
  • Knowledge of financial accounting concepts, including accounting for intercompany transactions; professional experience with Excel, Oracle, and Smart View; and enjoyment of working with and digging into data from multiple sources
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills, strong interpersonal and team-building capabilities across different functional areas and cultures, and curiosity, empathy, and humility

Preferred qualifications

  • An advanced degree or professional qualification in tax, accounting, economics, or law, such as a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential, Juris Doctor (JD), or Master of Laws (LLM)
  • Experience working in a high-growth, rapidly scaling environment
  • Working knowledge of Regulation W, Sections 23A and 23B of the Federal Reserve Act, or comparable affiliate transaction requirements, including pricing, documentation, governance, or monitoring considerations, with a practical understanding of how regulatory requirements affect operating models and affiliate arrangements
  • Experience with stablecoins, digital assets, wallets, on-chain financial infrastructure, payments, or treasury products

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Compliance team at Payward plays a critical role in enabling the company to grow responsibly while navigating a rapidly evolving regulatory environment. Our teams work across jurisdictions and product lines to design and maintain scalable compliance frameworks that support Payward’s mission while ensuring regulatory obligations are met.

The Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Scale Team is responsible for ensuring the FIU can scale, across new operating jurisdictions and new products, effectively and efficiently. The team leads AML transaction monitoring and blockchain monitoring to ensure thresholds are appropriately set, tested, and governed while reducing false positives and maintaining strong oversight. In addition, the team focuses on identifying efficiencies in process workflows and implementing automation across the FIU. Scale works closely with external vendor, Compliance, and internal technology teams.

 
 

The opportunity

  • Lead transaction monitoring optimization, including rule testing, threshold tuning, and the design and rollout of new monitoring scenarios to improve detection quality and reduce false positives

  • Identify and drive automation and workflow improvements across FIU processes to increase operational efficiency and effectiveness

  • Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, including LLM and AI-enabled tools, to enhance alert triage, investigations, SAR filing and FIU operational capabilities

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations to support vendor integrations, monitoring infrastructure improvements, and FIU tooling enhancements

  • Collaborate with Compliance leadership, including RCOs and MLROs, to maintain well-governed transaction monitoring frameworks aligned with regulatory expectations

  • Support FIU scalability by designing processes and monitoring strategies that enable expansion into new products, regions, and increased transaction volumes

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in AML, financial crime compliance, or FIU operations, with deep knowledge of transaction monitoring frameworks, suspicious activity detection, and regulatory expectations under BSA/AML regimes

  • 3+ years of experience designing, testing, and tuning transaction monitoring rules, including threshold optimization, scenario design, and alert reduction strategies

  • 3+ years of experience working with transaction monitoring systems and compliance tooling, including case management platforms, monitoring infrastructure, and investigative workflows

  • Experience working in a regulated financial institution, preferably one licensed to operate in the EU, UK, and/or United States

  • Experience driving process optimization or automation initiatives within compliance or financial crime programs to improve operational efficiency and scalability

About us

Relay is a cross-chain payments protocol that provides instant, low-cost cross-chain bridging, swaps, and transactions. We're the fastest and cheapest way to bridge and transact across chains, serving over 5 million users who have completed 59+ million transactions with $6+ billion in volume across 85+ chains.

Our mission is to make transacting across chains as fast, cheap, and reliable as online payments. We are building the core infrastructure to abstract chains from end user payments, enabling the next billion users to experience the benefits of blockchain without the UX burdens.

About the role

We're hiring a full-stack engineer who cares deeply about security to work side by side with our Head of Security, who leads security at Relay. Money moves through our systems 24/7, and attackers, from address poisoners to MEV searchers, are watching the same flows we are. Your job is to make Relay a hard target and to make security something product teams can build in, not bolt on.


Development runs in containers. Production access is read-only by default, with a written path for state-changing actions. Decisions are recorded with their evidence and reviewed later. We lean on AI-assisted tooling, including our own audit agents, and expect you to extend it rather than start over.

In this role, you'll own several production security systems end to end, each of which is a detection or denial control, and you'll partner with product engineers to ship security features that users and integrators can see and trust. This is an individual contributor, hands-on full-stack engineering role. You'll write code every day, deploy it, and run it in production: building services and the tools and interfaces around them, instrumenting them, setting up monitoring and alerts, and being on call for what you ship.

What you'll do

Own our wallet screening microservice

  • Own the service that screens wallet addresses before and during transactions: verdict quality, caching and rescreening behavior, latency, and uptime

  • Recommend and integrate risk vendors and data sources, and decide at which stage of a transaction (quote, deposit, fill, refund) and on which chains and address roles (sender, recipient, intermediary) each one applies

  • Make blocking decisions explainable: clear error codes and messages for integrators, and auditable reports of what was blocked and why

  • Build the override and watchlist tooling around the service with caller authorization, confirmation steps, and an audit trail

  • Handle partner and compliance requests about screening coverage, including blocked-address reporting

  • Keep the fail-closed guarantees honest across every flow that moves funds, including refunds, and prove it with tests

Own our sandwich-attack tracker

  • Turn the tracker into a production system that detects sandwich attacks and other MEV extraction against our users' transactions, in near real time

  • Measure it: precision and recall against labelled cases, per chain, with the back-test suite in CI

  • Quantify impact by chain, route, and integrator, and trace attacks back to where a transaction became visible

  • Work with Solving, Infrastructure and Protocol engineers to design mitigations, such as private submission, routing changes, and slippage guidance, and measure whether they work

  • Run investigations with our Head of Security when an incident is live and write up what happened and what changed

Maintain Vigil, our internal auditing tool

  • Own Vigil as a product for our engineers: keep it reliable, keep its checks current, and decide what it audits next

  • Treat it as what it is, an LLM-driven audit harness: prompt and rule changes are production changes, every false-positive rule carries evidence, and a regression set keeps it honest

  • Keep findings triage accurate and actionable, with clear severity, ownership, and a path from finding to fix (including delegation to our internal AI agent and Linear tickets)

  • Cut noise and false positives so teams trust Vigil's findings and act on them

  • Extend Vigil as our systems and threats change, feed incidents back into it, and make sure its findings feed the screening service, the sandwich tracker, and product security work

Build the detection and response loop

  • Run the daily loss review as an automated job with alerting, and own the monitors that catch mispricing, unexpected refunds, and fills that deviate from their quotes

  • Build the watchlist and early-warning pipeline that denies exit rails to the proceeds of third-party hacks within the hour

  • Write the postmortem, that pertain to your domain, and turn its lessons into a check, a monitor, or a rule

Build security features with product teams

  • Sit with product teams at design time to threat-model new features, especially anything that moves, holds, or refunds funds

  • Build shared security building blocks (permissions, caller-scoped reads with field allowlists, audit trails, secrets handling, rate and abuse controls) so teams reuse them instead of reinventing them

  • Review changes for security risk and help teams adopt secure-by-default patterns

  • Use AI-assisted tooling to review code, enumerate attack paths, and triage findings faster

About you

  • You build the feedback loop for your own judgement: back-tests, regression sets and post-incident checks, because the misses that cost the most looked harmless at first

  • You've run security-sensitive systems in production

  • You enjoy working with product engineers and can turn a threat model into a change they're glad to make

  • You're curious about crypto's adversarial conditions: MEV, mempools, address poisoning, sanctioned and illicit flows

  • You're comfortable being on call for 24/7 financial infrastructure and calm during live incidents

  • You write things down: a decision with its evidence, an incident with its timeline, a finding with its severity and owner
